newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hui Shung buys 108,000T U.S. soy/corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hui Shung buys 108,000T U.S. soy/corn.

text.p: Taiwan's Hui Shung group on Wednesday bought two combined shipments of U.S. soybeans and corn totalling 108,000 tonnes from Continental, traders said.
Each shipment includes 38,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn, the traders said.
The tender includes options for Hui Shung to buy an additional 500 tonnes of soybeans from Continental Grain Co under the fixed-price portion of each shipment, they said.
Contract terms include a plus-or-minus five percent loading allowance, they said.
The Hui Shung Group includes Hui Shung Agriculture and Food Corp, Eagle Food Industry and Charoen Pokphand.
Traders said both shipments were fixed on a cost-and-freight basis.
Details for the tender are as follows:
One 16,000 corn U.S. Gulf Pacific N.W. 89.55 US Cents/Mar
One 22,000 soy Jan 5-20 Jan 21-Feb 4 90.00 US Cents/Mar
Two 16,000 corn U.S. Gulf Pacific N.W. 92.55 US Cents/Mar
Two 22,000 soy Feb 5-20 Feb 21-Mar 7 91.90 US Cents/Mar
